Recently I discovered the use of tea tree oil for killing the fungus........and for me it seems to be working. However, it will be awhile before the part of my nails that were affected by the fungus grow out. I was heading out for vacation and really wanted to be able to wear flip - flops, so I needed to be able to polish my nails.. I was afraid to use regular nail polish on my toes. I have had toenail fungus before and tend to get it rather easily so I do my own toenails and always use this kind of polish. It breathes better than other polishes and has tea tree oil which I use regularly on my nails because it will cure and prevent fungal infections. I often use tea tree oil with the polish and the oil does not seem to affect the polish much or any. The polish also lasts well.

I like the function (using to cover and help heal nails while growing out that had fungus due to long term use of acrylic nails) however it doesn't cover well at all and doesn't last real long either. Better than having nail fungus in plain sight. You'll need at least 3 coats to make it look even and not be too transparent.

reviews.t: Loyal Linen shade -- a lovely sheer polish with benefits
reviews.x: This is my favorite shade in this line of polish. I found the others to be a bit streaky, but "Loyal Linen" is a natural looking, SHEER shade that goes on well and disguises the horrific damage I got when I had "dipping" done at the salon. When the dipping polish was removed at the salon, my remaining natural nails were terribly damaged and I had a fungus infection in one of my finger nails.  I ended up discovering Dr.'s Remedy polishes in order to heal the infection and disguise my ruined nails

reviews.t: It's streaks and goes on like Elmer's Glue
reviews.x: This is the worst nail polish I have ever used. It went on very thick and was so dry, that I had to go over it several times. It streaked quite badly. It was not worth $20.  I did like the color, but not the consistency and application.  I am returning it, but I have to pay for the shipping which is very upsetting because the product was such bad quality.
Soulful Slate Blue..... beautiful color, great coverage.  Just love how my feet look!  I received a lot of compliments on the color.

reviews.t: Trusting turquoise is perfect. And my nail fungus is getting better ...
reviews.x: Beautiful color TRUSTING TURQUOISE. The color deepens after it dries to a perfect Robins Egg color and sheen.  This bottle has Smooth application. Love the extra large curved brush. My last bottle of this brand didn’t have that and I never could get the color evenly applied on my big toes. Now that I see how well this color went on and dried, I think the other color I bought last year was old or defective because it would dry before I could finish the whole big toe and end up with streaks and sm

This product really seems to be working!!! I purchased it to help with healing (and hiding!!) a toenail fungus...Didn’t see results overnight, though. Had to be patient. Has taken consistent use for about 6-9 months, but I’m seeing a big difference in the health of my toenails.
I know this product doesn’t claim to cure the fungus, nut mine disappeared after a few months of wearing this polish. It’s also very easy to remove, leaves no stain behind. It’s worth every penny.

Update: it's been three weeks and my pedicure is finally starting to chip, but only on one nail! Probably the longest lasting polish ive tried! Plus, I can see improvements to my nail. I highly recommend!!  The color is perfect! No need for a second coat. I love the natural ingredients in this nail polish; If they actually do help with my yellow, brittle nails. Although, I read from other reviewers that the smell of the nail polish is not as harsh and that is not true. The smell is still strong,

reviews.t: Minimal smell, seems to work, I recommend !
reviews.x: I stopped going to nail salons since the salons cause the fungus in the first place. Since using this nail polish, my nails seem healthier. The off putting smell is still there but not as potent or long lasting. In order for this polish to work you need 3 small coats and it will look beautiful. For the fungus to clear up you still need other sources. I've used the polish for a week now. Thank you for reading.

Very pretty light pink color if you want a more natural look.  It is sheer so you may want 2 or 3 coats if you prefer more coverage.  Goes on easily and I would purchase again.  I have about 5 colors of Dr. Remedy and since using it for pedicures my nails have been very healthy  .... not so with regular polish.

This is a pretty good polish, quality wise. The problem, imo, is that the picture would lead you to believe this is lighter pink color. I can assure you it is not. It is the exact same color as Pepto Bismol.  I’d give it a 4.5 if the color wasn’t so horrid.

So nice to do my nails and not feel that I am destroying them. The polish doesn't go on quite as smoothly but it's full of Tea Tree oil (whatever that is) so it has to be healthy, right? Anyway, it's pricey but I think it's worth every penny.

reviews.t: Better nail discoloration coverage than Precious Pink
reviews.x: Better nail discoloration coverage than Precious Pink. Only takes 2 coats. The perfect summer color for tan feet/legs. Holds up very well even after 2 weeks but I also added Dr's REMEDY 2-in-1 clear coat as a protective topcoat.

reviews.t: Don't buy this unless you just want shine!
reviews.x: This nail polish does not cover anything and is more like streaky clear than Petal Pink. Very disappointed and non returnable!! What a waste of $17.00!!
I love this color!  I was afraid it would be really thin and need several coats, but it's nice!

I have been using this polish for years! It always goes on nicely. Some colors last longer than others depending on my activity. This Beloved Blush is very pink! I was expecting a more “blush” look, so I am a bit disappointed. UPDATE: I have had this color on for a few days and It’s unflattering. Someone told me I look like an Easter egg. This can’t be returned.

Works and the colors are nice and last a long time. I would compare it to Essie brand as far as quality and color. I started using after I got a toenail fungus from a local upscale spa. GRRR! Podiatrist is who recommended it and I will continue to use.
I am so pleased with this product. Every time I have an outbreak of fungus I just polish my toes and it goes away this is the best product ever.
The polish stays on for a long time.  Great product that I would recommend.  Little pricey but worth the money.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the polish helps improve or cure their toenail fungus, often noting it takes months of consistent use.
Reviewers frequently praise the colors and coverage, with some calling the shades beautiful and long-lasting.
Several reviewers mention their podiatrist recommended this brand specifically.
Some reviewers complain the polish is streaky, thick, and requires multiple coats for even coverage.
A few reviewers note the polish has a noticeable but reduced smell compared to other polishes.

qa.q: Is this nail polish safe for sensitive skin or allergies?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: How long does the polish last before chipping?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on longevity: some say it stays on for a long time [2] and lasted well [4], while another says it doesn't last real long [1]. No review gives a specific time before chipping.

claims.text: The polish stays on for a long time.

qa.q: Does it have a strong smell?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the smell as minimal or less potent than expected [1], though one review notes other reviewers mentioned the smell [2].

claims.text: The smell is described as minimal and less potent or long lasting than expected.
One review references reading from other reviewers about the smell.

qa.q: Is the color true to the picture?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say the color is not true to the picture, describing it as much pinker than expected [1][6], while others call the color perfect or a pretty light pink [2][5].

claims.text: One reviewer says the picture suggests a lighter pink but the actual color is not, comparing it to Pepto Bismol [1].
Another reviewer expected a more blush look but found the color very pink and unflattering [6].
Other reviewers describe the color as perfect and a very pretty light pink [2][5].

qa.q: Is it worth the price compared to regular polish?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on whether it's worth the price: one reviewer calls it pricey but worth every penny [4], while another calls it a waste of $17.00 [6]. One reviewer also says their nails have been healthier with this than with regular polish [5].

claims.text: One reviewer calls it pricey but worth every penny.
Another reviewer calls it a waste of $17.00.
One reviewer says their nails have been healthier with this than with regular polish.
